hypotheses.basis: The policy is a universal conditional prohibition: in every case where an account is frozen, outgoing transfers must not be permitted. A violation occurs when the account is frozen but outgoing transfers are not blocked (i.e., still allowed).
unresolved_terms: outgoing transfer (scope of what constitutes an outgoing transfer)
allow (mechanism of authorization)
account (which accounts are in scope)

hypotheses.basis: The policy could be read as a complete specification (closed-world reading): 'Whenever an account is frozen, do not allow an outgoing transfer' defines the ONLY condition under which blocking is required. Under this reading, blocking when the account is NOT frozen is also a violation, because the policy exhaustively specifies when transfers must be blocked. This differs from the open-world reading (existing) which only prohibits allowing transfers when frozen but is silent about blocking when not frozen.
unresolved_terms: Whether the policy is intended as an open-world rule (one of possibly many conditions for blocking) or a closed-world complete specification (the only condition for blocking).
